provenance.source: PR #3862 fix: 301 and 302 change method to GET, squash-merged 2024-11-21 as 0d0655262
provenance.note: The PR added the 301/302 POST-to-GET rewrite, but at the end of onHeaders: below the location computation (which nulls location when the body is disturbed) and below the early return that hands a non-followed response straight to the next handler, so the rewrite cannot run for a response that is not followed and a POST whose body is a stream is never followed even though its body is about to be discarded. The later fix #3873 moves the block above the location computation and drops the body first.

keywords: the method rewrite happens too late
placed below the check that decides whether to follow
disturbed body never follows the redirect
bugs.note: the rewrite sits below the location computation and the pass-through return, so a 301/302 POST with a stream body stops redirecting although the body would be thrown away; the fix moves it above both
